query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.articles) AS articles_total, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.articles WHERE jsonb_typeof(claims) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(claims) > 0) AS articles_with_claims_json, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.articles WHERE body_text IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(body_text)) > 0) AS articles_with_body, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.articles WHERE author_id IS NOT NULL) AS articles_with_author_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.authors) AS author_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT article_id) FROM public.citations) AS articles_with_citations, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.citations) AS citation_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.article_extraction_results) AS extraction_result_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.article_extraction_results WHERE state = 'candidate') AS candidate_extraction_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.article_extraction_results WHERE state = 'failed') AS failed_extraction_rows LIMIT 1;
